Every year, nearly 21,000 families in our country tragically lose a child to stillbirth. While dealing with this loss, these families not only have to grapple with grief, but also make difficult financial decisions to cover medical costs, funeral expenses, and much more during one of their darkest moments. On National Stillbirth Prevention and Awareness Day, we recognize the families who lost their children far too soon and the challenges they face for years to come.

That’s why during my time in the Maryland Senate, I introduced a bill to ensure Maryland families have the time and resources to properly honor their child, rather than worrying about their finances during one of their most challenging moments. I’m grateful that bill has finally passed this year thanks to the tireless work of Senator Waldstreicher and my state partners.
